column_description: Unique identifier for each access event.
ID of the cell being accessed. may be NULL.
ID of the user accessing the cell. may be NULL.
Date when the cell data was accessed. may be NULL.
Type of access (e.g., view, download). always exactly one of 'view', 'download'. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the access log was created. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the access log was last updated. may be NULL.
